metadata.description: Work mods that make Claude clearer and cleaner, and pixel games that play themselves while you work.

plugins.name: change-journal
plugins.description: A live HTML page that shows every change Claude makes, with diffs, the reason for each edit, checks, and before/after behavior flows.

plugins.name: decision-lens
plugins.description: See the decisions Claude made in each turn, why it made them, and steer future turns with keep and avoid rules.

plugins.name: grill
plugins.description: While Claude works on your task, a sharp partner asks the questions that change the result. Answers reach Claude mid-turn. Brainstorm and side chat modes too.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Finds AI slop in Claude's changes (dashes, comment blocks, comments that repeat the code, tests that assert nothing, filler phrases) and tells Claude to remove it. Shows what was unslopped.

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: Notices when Claude drifts outside your request. Clear drift waits for your answer in a question dialog; milder drift is flagged above the prompt with a pull-back key.

plugins.name: looks
plugins.description: Make Claude Code look the way you like: one-line tool calls, replies centered at a reading width, and four themes (Retro CRT, Punk, Synthwave, Zen paper) switched with /theme.

plugins.name: samurai-dojo
plugins.description: A Claude samurai cuts down a Codex, Gemini, or ChatGPT foe for every tool call, and meditates, trains, and duels between them through four seasons.

plugins.name: slayer-corps
plugins.description: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu, and Inosuke take turns against demons up to Muzan as you and Claude work, and spar between strikes. The story continues every session.

plugins.name: night-feast
plugins.description: A vampire feeds on every tool call Claude finishes while the moon tracks how full the context window is. Between meals it stalks, swoops, and lies in wait. Dawn means it is time to compact.

plugins.name: little-harvest
plugins.description: Every file that changes becomes a crop: Claude's edits and yours grow a farm in its own pane, tests bring sun or storms, and passing turns fill the barn.

plugins.name: pocket-familiar
plugins.description: A fox spirit that lives on your work: passing tests feed it, finished turns cheer it, it plays while you are quiet, and it grows up to nine tails.
